observations.behavior: Adds a check to raise LearningConflictingOutput when multiple parallel tool calls produce different inputs.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent the Knowledge Learning system from publishing conflicting or inconsistent AI-generated knowledge. It also adds structured error handling rather than failing immediately.

observations.behavior: Changes Anthropic API call to disable parallel tool use while retaining the ability to handle cases where several sequential results arrive.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces risk of duplicate or contradictory outputs by forcing single-call behavior; downstream recovery relies on selecting one candidate instead of treating it as an immediate failure.

observations.behavior: Adds Pydantic field validator that maps unknown rejection codes to a conservative default before further processing.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides fail-closed protection against unexpected model responses without changing control flow; this preserves existing publication decisions while avoiding schema violations.

These are substantive but remain localized within the learning analysis workflow rather than systemic architectural changes.
review.posthog_relevance: Could improve reliability and consistency of AI-generated knowledge entries by preventing conflicting publications and handling edge-case model behaviors more gracefully.
review.uncertainty: Assessment does not account for broader system dependencies, deployment behavior, or real-world performance. No tier 3 evidence exists.
